backend/clues.mo: Defines a simple clues module with CRUD operations using a map and incremental IDs.
backend/main.mo: Implements the main actor with access control, user profiles, and admin‑restricted clue creation, editing, and ID reassignment.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping a specific feature to related frontend files, components, and tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for various frontend files used across the app.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind-based theme variables and styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures the TanStack Router with Echofields routes, redirects, layout, and theming provider.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with attribution, styling, and build metadata display.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Renders a sticky header with navigational branding linking to /echofields.
Displays clue text and renders image, video, or PPT media with safety checks and fallbacks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Initializes anonymous or authenticated backend actors and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including loading, login, logout, and status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating clue data through an actor, including summaries, individual clues, answers, and admin actions.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets global styles, Tailwind layers, and theme variables for light and dark modes with a liminal aesthetic.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Implements an admin interface for authenticated owners to create, edit, delete, and manage clues using various query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/CluePage.tsx: Displays an individual clue, handles answer submission, gating logic, and navigation to the next clue.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page showing intro animation, welcome text, and start button that navigates to the first available clue.
frontend/src/utils/buildInfo.ts: Defines static build metadata including version, description, and timestamp.
frontend/src/utils/clueConsistency.ts: Tracks deleted clues and bulk clear operations to filter out stale clue data for 10 seconds.
frontend/src/utils/humanizeError.ts: Converts unknown or structured errors into readable messages with special handling for common cases.
frontend/src/utils/pasteRichMedia.ts: Detects pasted media URLs and transforms them into markup, and provides utilities for cursor insertion.
frontend/src/utils/safeUrl.ts: Validates URLs for supported schemes and distinguishes internal vs external routes.
frontend/src/utils/sessionGating.ts: Manages session-based start gating and clue progression using sessionStorage.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, animations, fonts, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata detailing versions, issues, and feature requests related to fixing clue creation.
